name: Greg Ginis
bio:
Greg has proudly served the Jackson Soccer Club in several leadership roles over the years, including Director of Grounds, Vice President, and currently President. Throughout his tenure, Greg has remained committed to improving the club's facilities, strengthening the club's financial position, and creating the best possible experience for players and families.

One of Greg's most significant accomplishments has been negotiating and securing a 20-year lease agreement with Jackson Township for the Jackson Mills soccer complex, providing the club with long-term stability and the ability to invest confidently in its facilities. Greg also led the project to install LED field lighting at Jackson Mills, significantly expanding field availability for practices and games while improving the overall player experience. To help make this project financially responsible, Greg successfully introduced a grant that covered 50% of the lighting project's cost, reducing the financial impact on the club.

Outside of his volunteer leadership, Greg is also a Jackson Soccer Club parent. His two sons currently play in the club's 2011 and 2014 age groups, giving him firsthand insight into the experience of players and families. Having lived in Jackson for the past 15 years, Greg is deeply invested in the community and committed to ensuring that Jackson Soccer Club continues to grow and provide outstanding opportunities for current and future generations of players.

As President, Greg's focus remains on building a stronger, more sustainable club by investing in facilities, supporting player development, maintaining financial responsibility, and creating an environment where every player has the opportunity to learn, compete, and enjoy the game. Greg looks forward to continuing to add value to Jackson Soccer Club and serving the families that make the organization such an important part of the community.

name: Hagos Rush
bio:
Hagos has been a coach with Jackson Soccer Club for more than two years and currently serves as Head Coach of Jackson United Red. What initially began as an opportunity to coach his son quickly developed into a genuine passion for teaching the game and watching players grow in their confidence, skills, and understanding of soccer.

His coaching philosophy focuses on developing intelligent, team focused players who learn to make decisions for themselves. He believes players should be encouraged to take chances, make mistakes, learn from them, and respond with maximum effort. Above all, his goal is to create an environment where players enjoy the game, develop as teammates and individuals, and build skills that extend beyond the soccer field.

Hagos is also a U.S. Soccer referee who has officiated at the ECNL Regional League Finals. He holds U.S. Soccer 7v7, 9v9, and 11v11 coaching licenses and is currently working toward his D License. Outside of soccer, he brings more than 14 years of leadership and people development experience, including coaching, mentoring, training, and building high performing teams.

A Jackson resident since 2020, Hagos joined the Board with a simple goal: to be helpful wherever he can. As Assistant Director of Fields & Grounds, he works alongside the Director to support and protect the club's facilities while exploring ways technology can improve how the club operates. He is also leading the redevelopment of the Jackson Soccer Club website and assists with MOSA responsibilities, including attending league meetings and sharing information back with the club.

name: Mike Pinto
bio:
Mike Pinto is the volunteer Registrar for the Jackson Soccer Club. He has held the position for about a year and a half, and before that served two years as a recreational coach. He is currently the head coach of the travel U9 Boys Strikers, a role he has held for the past two seasons, and he has also coached flag football and currently coaches basketball as well.

He handles team rosters, player registration, and league administration so that coaches and players can focus entirely on the game. He also helps manage the club's social media pages, including Facebook, Instagram, and X.

A local parent of two, Mike is thrilled to support the community and help make every season organized and fun for everyone.
